senses.gloss:
खड r. 10th cl. (खाडयति) also (इ,) खडि r. 1st and 10th cls. (खण्डति,
खण्डयति) and (इ ङ) खडिङ् r. 1st cl. (खण्डते) To divide, ‘to tear, to
break off a part or piece.

खड m. (-डः)
 1. Breaking, dividing.
 2. Buttermilk boiled with acid
[]
vegetables and spices.
 3. A small grass.
 f. (-डी) Chalk.
 E. खड्. to
break, &c. affix अच्.

खडक्किका f. (-का) A private or back door, a small venetian door or
window.

खडिका f. (-का) Chalk.
 E. खड्. to break, affix वुन्, fem. form.

खडु m. (-डुः) A bier.
 E. खड्. to break, affix उ.

खड्ग m. (-ड्गः) A rhinoceros.
 2. A rhinocero's horn.
 3. A sword, a scymi-
tar.
 4. A large sacrificial knife.
 5. One of the Buddhas or Baud-
dha saints.
 n. (-ड्गं) Iron.
 E. खड्. to tear or rend, Uṇādi affix गन.

खड्गकोष m. (-षः)
 1. A creeping plant, (Scripus maximus.)
 2. A scab-
bard, a sheathe.
 E. खड्ग a sword. and कोष a sheathe.

खड्गचर्म्मधर m. (-रः) A soldier armed with a sword and shield.
 E. खड्ग,
and चर्म्म a shield, धर who bears.

खड्गट m. (-टः) A large kind of Kas, (Saccharum spontaneum.)
 E. खड्ग the
rhinoceros, and अट who goes; these animals being usually found
amongst high grass or reeds.

खड्गधर m. (-रः) A swordsman.
 E. खड्ग, and धर who holds.

खड्गाधार m. (-रः) A sheathe, a scabbard.
 E. खड्ग, and आधार what receives.

खड्गधेनु f. (-नुः)
 1. A small knife.
 2. A female rhinoceros.
 E. खड्ग a sword
&c. धेनु a cow, used here as a diminutive.

खड्गपत्र m. (-त्रः) The name of a creeper. (Scirpus maximus.)
 n. (-त्रं) The
blade of a sword.
 E. खड्ग a sword, and पत्र leaf.

खड्गपात्र n. (-त्रं) A vessel of buffalo's horn.
 E. खड्ग and पात्र a vessel.

खड्गपाणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) Holding a sword.
 E. खड्ग, and पाणि the hand.

खड्गपिधान n. (-नं) A scabbard, a sheathe.
 E. खड्ग a sword, and पिधान a
sheathe; also with कन् added, खड्गपिधानक.

खड्गपुत्रिका f. (-का) A knife, a small sword.
 E. खड्ग, and पुत्तिका infant.

खड्गप्रहार m. (-रः) A sword cut.
 E. खड्ग, and प्रहार a stroke.

खड्गमांस m. (-सः) Buffalo-beef.
 E. खड्ग, and मांस flesh.
खड्गलेखा f. (-खा) A row of sabres. खड्ग, and लेखा a line.

खड्गराट m. (-टः)
 1. A shield. One who observes a peculiar religious obli-
gation, rubbing the feet backwards and forwards on the edge of a
sword made red hot, this is a penance peculiar to the Bauddhas.
E. खड्ग a sword, रट् to speak, deriv. irr.

खड्गाघात m. (-तः) A sword cut.
 E. खड्ग, and आघात a blow.

खड्गाभिहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cut or struck with a sword.
 E. खड्ग, and अभि-
हत struck.

खड्गामिष n. (-षं) Buffalo's flesh.
 E. खड्ग, and आमिष flesh.

खड्गिक m. (-कः)
 1. The cream or froth of buffalo's milk.
 2. A vender of
flesh meat.
 E. खड्ग a sword, &c. affix ठक्.

खड्गीक m. (-कः) A sickle, a scythe.
 E. खड्ग a scymitar, and इकन् aff.

खड्गिन् mfn. (-ड्गी-ड्गिनी-ड्गि) Armed with a sword.
 m. (-ड्गी)
 1. A rhinoceros.
2. A Jina or Jaina saint.
 E. खड्ग a horn, &c. affix इनि.

खड्गिमार m. (-रः) A kind of creeper: see खड्गकोष.
 E. खड्गि a rhinoceros,
and मार what destroys.
